note: Held tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation for the BMC Kirpi mine-resistant ambush protected vehicle, uplifted by a held tier-4 BMC maker technical specifications page. The held BMC page supplies the length, width, height, ground clearance, gross vehicle weight, engine model and displacement, peak torque, net power, automatic transmission and gear count, tyre size code, maximum road speed, fording depth and range for the KIRPI 4X4. The compilation figure for the operating weight stays at grade claimed, because the maker publishes a gross vehicle weight and not an operating weight. The held bytes are on disk under data/vehicle/sources/ and their digest matches the registry entry.
